responsibility: Provides forward declarations and target-specific helper macros for the Blackfin backend routines that are referenced from the machine description and other headers but cannot be declared in bfin.h because of include dependencies. It centralizes prototypes for argument passing, address legitimacy, PIC and call expansion, operand printing, prologue/epilogue emission, multi-register save/restore analysis, varargs, alignment, hardware loop support, and silicon-anomaly workaround flags that guide code generation decisions.
